evidence: Built a requirement->criterion map over instruction.md + hireops_rules.md + integration.md against 2 gate, 15 functional, 5 polish and 5 visual criteria. Broad coverage is strong: job opening and validation (places 1-50 integer, blank title, manager from HM accounts) and candidate intake/email validation/case-insensitive duplicate/field-kept refusal -> hro_intake_restart; one-stage moves, skips, optimistic first-look, in-stage order and shared order -> hro_moves; reject/reason/reopen-to-origin/reason cleared/Hired not rejectable -> hro_reject_reopen; 409 + who -> hro_two_people; Interview capacity (single, replay, re-order inside full, freed place, undo overfill) + rollback/reason/focus -> hro_interview_places; bulk all-or-none, board order, cross-stage set, capacity for the set, skip in set -> hro_bulk; undo own latest, single/several, place restore, reason restore, refusal after move/re-order/reject/reopen by anyone, note does not count, once-only, later move supersedes -> hro_undo (+ hro_reject_reopen); Activity kinds, reason, newest first, all/one job filter, refused leaves no line, Observer reads -> hro_activity; HM late-stage scope, own-job notes, Observer reads notes -> hro_manager_roles; 401/403/404 and session-only identity (replay of observed body in another session) -> hro_readonly_roles; conversation roles, plain text, blank refused, Enter/Shift+Enter, line breaks, empty+focused after send -> hro_messaging; per-conversation drafts, other view, reload, sending clears -> hro_drafts; 30-page/oldest-first/newest scroll/remaining count/scrolled-up notice and unread -> hro_long_thread + hro_pol_earlier_place; unread per person, total, own never unread, seed read markers (Lena=1, a candidate unread count), seen rules incl. Observer never counts and HM/recruiter seeing candidate message -> hro_unread_seen; candidate wording, title/team, privacy of every received payload, staff reads refused -> hro_candidate; live-update preservation of open card, note text, focus, scroll, open conversation -> hro_pol_live_board/hro_pol_live_thread; failed send -> hro_pol_failed_send; ended session prompt, draft survives sign-in, other user on same browser sees neither reply nor note draft -> hro_pol_session_resume; restart durability with multiple recorded revisions and idempotent seed -> hro_intake_restart (Colderwater lesson 15 satisfied); runtime contract (PORT, DB_PATH, health, server.js) -> test.sh launch, not a judge gap. Workbook internal annotation and skill false-positive applied: bundled flows are not gaps. Remaining UNGRADED stated requirements (every gap): (G1) hireops_rules.md:159-160 'sending a message counts as reading the conversation' - no criterion leg sends while unread messages are pending and then reads the count (hro_unread_seen and hro_long_thread clear unread only by opening/going to the newest). (G2) hireops_rules.md:94 'Each card still has to follow every rule above' for multi-card moves - hro_bulk grades only skip and capacity; 'Who may move what' (lines 68-74) in a multi-card move is graded only for Observer/candidate/anonymous replays (hro_readonly_roles), never for a hiring manager (Ingrid's late-stage limit or Bill on a job not his), and rejected/Hired cards in a set are never tried. (G3) hireops_rules.md:64 with :99 (reopen counts as a move) - Interview capacity on a reopen into a full Interview is never tried; hro_reject_reopen and hro_manager_roles reopen only when capacity is free. (G4, minor/partial) hireops_rules.md:81-82 'Their board then catches up to where the card really is' after a 409 - hro_two_people checks server state via replay and the 409 body, and live catch-up generally, but not the sending page's own correction after a stale refusal. (Indirect only, not counted as a gap) hireops_rules.md:188-189 'signing in doesn't open one for them' is exercised indirectly by hro_unread_seen step 1 (Lena's count read without opening) and step 4 (Tomas's list page must not mark Rafael's message seen). G1-G3 are explicit sentences of the public notes with no grading leg; per REVIEW_POLICY 'Every mandatory product behavior needs evidence' they are coverage gaps. Bounded impact (sub-rules of otherwise well-graded features), hence P2.
counterexample: Broken app A: the bulk-move endpoint checks stage adjacency and Interview capacity but not role/job ownership, so Ingrid (HM) selects one Applied card and one Interview card on her job and moves both to Screen in one action (both forbidden for her), or Bill bulk-moves J1 cards - every criterion still passes because hro_manager_roles uses only single moves and hro_bulk runs only as Rafael. Broken app B: the read marker advances only on open/scroll-to-newest, never on send; Rafael scrolled up with one unread Noor message sends his reply and the count stays 1 - no criterion observes this. Broken app C: capacity is checked on move/bulk/undo but not on reopen; with 2 places, reject A from Interview, move E in (2/2), reopen A to Interview -> 3/2 accepted - no criterion tries it.
suggested_fix: Either add short legs (hro_manager_roles: Ingrid tries one multi-card move mixing a late-stage card with an Applied card, refused with nothing moved, Rafael's same set as control; hro_interview_places: reopen a card rejected from Interview while Interview is full, refused, then accepted once a place frees; hro_long_thread: after the scrolled-up unread check, send the typed reply and read that the conversation's unread count is 0) or, if workload forbids, remove/soften the 'sending counts as reading' sentence and narrow line 94 in hireops_rules.md so no stated requirement goes ungraded; re-review rows 6/27/28/31 and workload after the change.
